subject: Língua Portuguesa
description_pt: Ler e compreender, de forma autônoma, textos literários de diferentes gêneros e extensões, inclusive aqueles sem ilustrações, estabelecendo preferências por gêneros, temas, autores.

components.description_pt: Ler textos literários de nível escolar, incluindo histórias, dramas e poesia, independente e proficientemente
components.description_en: Read grade-level literary texts, including stories, dramas, and poetry, independently and proficiently
components.cc_component_description: Read grade-level literary texts, including stories, dramas, and poetry, independently and proficiently

components.description_pt: Engajar-se com textos literários de variados comprimentos, incluindo aqueles sem ilustrações
components.description_en: Engage with literary texts of varying lengths, including those without illustrations
components.cc_component_description: Read grade-level literary texts independently without scaffolding or support

components.description_pt: Identificar preferências pessoais por gêneros, temas e autores baseado em experiência de leitura
components.description_en: Identify personal preferences for genres, themes, and authors based on reading experience

cc_matches.description: By the end of the year, read and comprehend literature, including stories, dramas, and poetry, at the high end of the grades 4—5 text complexity band independently and proficiently.
By the end of the year, read and comprehend literature, including stories, dramas, and poems, at the high end of grades 6—8 text complexity band independently and proficiently.
